title: POUNCE Gate 1 flash result file
description: The gh#776 Gate 1 result contract. Every file stamps both repository commits, the model-data revision, the environment, the model constants and the full temperature path; and it keeps source-level quantities (phase regime, vapor fraction, balance and isofugacity residuals, complementarity products) strictly apart from POUNCE's own NLP/KKT diagnostics, because an MPCC lowering's NLP residuals are residuals of a different problem. The DiscOpt entry records that no GDP/SOS1 comparison was run and why, rather than being absent: 'no comparison was run' and 'a comparison was run and its commit was not recorded' are different claims.

discopt.description: Whether a DiscOpt comparison was run. `comparison_run` is false in every file produced so far: the reduced GDP/SOS1 cross-validation gh#776 asks for is blocked on jkitchin/discopt#1123. `reason` says so in words.

model_data_revision.description: SHA-256 prefix over the modules that define the fixture, including the upstream Peng-Robinson layer. Two files whose revisions differ are two different benchmarks.

model.description: The model side of the stamp. The temperature path is recorded in full rather than as a count: gh#776 asks for the mesh, and on a flash the mesh is the path. A path summarized by its endpoints cannot be compared against another run's.

base_options.description: Pinned on every route: an iteration count compared across differently-converged solves measures nothing.

supported_route.description: The route gh#794 established and gh#776 asks Gate 1 to use.

oracle.description: The independent calculation, recorded in full so a reader can check the solver against it without re-running it.

sum_x.description: In a single-phase regime this IS the tangent-plane test's sum Y, directly comparable with the model's Sx.

trivial.description: K_i = 1 for every i: the classic false flash answer.

ambiguous.description: Both phase labels stable AND both incipient phases real: a metastable point.

no_incipient_phase.description: Neither label has a non-trivial stationary point. A formulation boundary: there the MPCC leaves beta undetermined.

hysteresis.description: Path dependence, which is what running the parameter in both directions is for. `cold_legs_agree` is a harness check rather than a physical result: the two cold legs solve identical problems from identical starts and must agree.

path_dependent.description: Any pair of legs reaching a different converged answer at the same temperature. The verdict the four legs exist to produce.

source.description: In the model's own units, computed from the source model at the returned point -- never read off the lowered NLP. The complementarity product is a source quantity whose floor is sqrt(tol), and must not be compared against tol.

validation.description: Source-level checks. Keys ending in _ok are pass/fail; null means the check does not apply at this point rather than that it passed.

nlp.description: POUNCE's own KKT diagnostics, scaled and unscaled, kept apart from everything source-level.

finish_applied.description: For a route with a finishing solve: whether it ran and was accepted. null where the route defines none. A record with ok=true and finish_applied=false ran the continuation half of its route only.
